prerequisites: Finished bachelor graduation from a Technical University.

learning_outcomes.text: Gain basic practical knowledge in computer aided techniques usage in metal forming, casting and welding processes through education.

syllabus_topics: Utilization of Numerical Simulation Method in Metal Forming, Casting and Welding Processes.
Basic data in tooling design for forgings and castings
Introduction into CAD in Foundry technology using NovaCAST software
Simulation of solidification of a steel casting and ductile iron casting
Simulation of mould filling and casting solidification
Basic features of QForm-2D and FORGE software
Proposal of a forging sequence, design of a forging model - simulation
Simulation - possible change of process parameters
Presentation of Magmasoft utilization in foundry industry
Presentation of Procast utilization in foundry industry
Presentation of Sysweld possibilities in welding industry
Presentation of FORGE/PAMSTAMP possibilities in forming industry
Evaluation of simulation results, comparison of different software for numerical simulation
bibliography: Návod k práci se simulačním softwarem NovaFlow&Solid ; Návod k práci se simulačním softwarem FormFEM
Herman a kol. Počítačové simulace ve slévárenství, ČVUT, 2001
